system.description:
You cloud the minds of your opponents, hindering their perception of the environment around them, veiling reality with twisted illusions.

All creatures of your choice within a 20-foot radius when this jutsu is cast must make a Wisdom saving throw or fall prey to the Fog of War as it becomes difficult to discern friend from foe in the heat of the moment.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist this Jutsu's effects.

Success: If the affected creature would attempt to make an attack or cast a jutsu that targets a creature before the end of their next turn, they must roll a d20. On a roll of 5 or lower they end up targeting the closest allied creature within 20-feet of their original target at random. This jutsu then ends.

Failure: For the duration, the first time each turn the affected creature would attempt to make an attack or cast a jutsu that targets a creature before the end of their next turn, they must roll a d20. On a roll of 8 or lower they end up targeting the closest allied creature within 20-feet of their original target at random.

Critical Failure: Same as failure but instead on a roll of 11 or lower the end up targeting the closest allied creature within 20-feet of their original target.
